candidate_selection: The five immutable *-qa-attempt-1.mp4 replacements named by media/brand-campaign-2026-07-27/quarantine/qa-attempt-1-probe-report.json were evaluated; superseded originals were not treated as candidates.

method.playability: Independent ffprobe -show_error -show_format -show_streams -count_frames inspection plus ffmpeg -v error -xerror full decode with the first video and audio streams mapped to the null muxer.
method.hash: SHA-256 over the exact candidate bytes at evaluation time.
method.visual: Settled-shot contact sheets were inspected for brand, palette, text, composition, and claim safety. Exact midpoint frames were independently decoded from every shot transition and assembled into media/brand-campaign-2026-07-27/qa/transition-midpoints-contact-sheet.jpg.
method.text_policy: Visible overlays were reconciled with deterministic COMPOSITION_TEXT and make_card definitions in render_campaign_videos.py. Output type sizes account for the renderer's 960x540 to 1920x1080 2x scale.
method.scientific_honesty: Every deterministic title, body, and disclosure was compared with the corresponding film's truthful thesis and claims_and_evidence_constraints.

global_findings.playability: PASS for all five candidates: valid MP4-family container at probe score 100, H.264 High@L4.0 1920x1080 yuv420p progressive video at 30 fps, AAC-LC mono 48 kHz audio, exact storyboard durations/frame counts, and clean full decode with empty stderr.
global_findings.brand_palette: PASS in settled shots: warm paper dominates, ink/soft-ink and indigo are restrained, and ochre is used only for cautions/abstention/boundary emphasis. No people, faces, plants, flowers, neon, dark backgrounds, glowing circuits, logos, or stock-3D/molecule-hero imagery were found.
global_findings.scientific_honesty: PASS for all five candidates: claims remain bounded by the storyboard evidence contracts and required draft/editorial/deployment qualifications are visible.
global_findings.blocking_text_policy: FAIL for all five candidates. The renderer produces 34 px body copy against the 48 px minimum, 20-24 px labels/footers against the 36 px minimum, and 18 px QA labels against the 36 px minimum. A single visible text node below the applicable floor is a rejection under docs/video-review-playbook.md.
global_findings.blocking_transition_integrity: FAIL for all five candidates. render_campaign_videos.py alpha-blends fully typeset outgoing and incoming cards for 12 frames (0.4 s). Every one of the 22 independently decoded transition midpoints contains simultaneous readable/ghosted text systems and focal competition, violating the zero-tolerance no-collision transition rule.
global_findings.publication_disposition: All five candidates are permanently excluded from wiring. No regeneration was requested or performed.
